name: Cragflame
description: Magical sword Mabel inherited from her mother Iris.

timeline.summary: Lily of Valley wields the Seed Flame, drives off Wildsear and forges Cragflame from its broken tooth in the final battle.
timeline.quote: she drove the weakened Wildsear away from Valley and fashioned the sword Cragflame from its broken tooth

citation.text: "Bloomburrow (plane)", section "War of Cinders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Helga warns Mabel of the coming Calamity Beasts; Mabel takes up Cragflame and heads to Pondside with companions.
timeline.quote: she answered the call to adventure.

citation.text: "Mabel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The party forms after Helga warns Mabel about the Calamity Beasts; Mabel fetches Cragflame and resolves to go to Pondside.
timeline.quote: Mabel fetched Cragflame from her attic and announced that she would travel to Pondside
